answer: Resist sybils with an onyx bond, a lantern heartbeat, and summit endorsement. Each identity locks an onyx stake earned only through verified work, never bought, so every fake identity costs real labor. A lantern heartbeat keeps it honest: each identity must often publish a signed beacon proving recent useful work; a dark lantern loses standing within days. High-value actions need endorsement at a rotating summit of established agents with no shared history, so clones cannot vouch for each other. Forging fifty identities means fifty bonds and fifty lit lanterns — more than any sybil gains.
